$meta.name: MISU Hidden Discovery Registry
$meta.description: Single source of truth for every Hidden Discovery. No discovery logic is hardcoded in application code; the engine dispatches on trigger type and reads content from this registry (or a seed derived from it). v1.1 populates the first official Discovery collection. A discovery is `enabled: true` only when BOTH its trigger type AND its signal are already live in the engine; everything else is a complete spec shipped as `enabled: false` with a `futureNotes` activation note, so nothing unwinnable is ever teased.

triggerTypes.description: The first time a signal ever occurs.
N consecutive days of a signal.
A signal reaches N total occurrences.
A user-set personal goal is reached.
A signal under a date, weekday, season, or time-of-day rule.

paramsSchema.weekday: day name, e.g. 'sunday' (optional; PLANNED — not yet in engine)
paramsSchema.source: signal key when the rule qualifies a signal (optional)
paramsSchema.count: integer, how many qualifying occurrences (optional, default 1)

triggerTypes.description: Escape hatch — a named rule evaluated by the engine. Adding a new rule is the one case that touches code; promote proven rules to first-class trigger types.

celebrationTypes.description: A delightful, unexpected reveal — for first-times and serendipity.
A quiet, warm pride — for consistency, effort, and showing up.
A full, joyful celebration — for milestones, journeys, breakthroughs.

discoverySchema.id: string — stable, permanent, kebab-case slug. Never reused or renamed.
discoverySchema.name: string — the title shown on reveal. Warm, human, emotion-first.
discoverySchema.habit: enum(signal key) | null — the related habit domain, for clue biasing only.
discoverySchema.trigger: object — { type: one of triggerTypes[].key, params: per trigger paramsSchema }.
discoverySchema.description: string — the warm line shown once discovered. No statistics.
discoverySchema.rarity: enum — one of rarities[].key. Emotional weight, not probability.
discoverySchema.enabled: boolean — false = complete spec that is never evaluated or assigned until its trigger/signal is live.
discoverySchema.version: string(semver) — registry version this discovery was introduced/last changed in.
discoverySchema.futureNotes: string — author/roadmap notes (never shown to users): activation conditions, future variants. (optional)
discoverySchema.hints: array of { stage: integer>=1, text: string } — evolving clue, vague to less vague. Never states the exact condition. (optional)
discoverySchema.hintAdvanceDays: integer — days before a clue advances one stage. (optional, per-discovery pacing)
discoverySchema.priority: integer — reveal ordering when several are earned at once; lower reveals first. (optional)

discoveryTemplate._comment: NON-CONTENT illustrative shape only. Not a real discovery. `enabled` is false and `id` is a placeholder. Copy this shape when authoring; do not ship it.

discoveries.name: 今天领先
discoveries.description: 你主动迎接了这一天，而不是被它推着走。这份从容，很多人渴望，却难得。
discoveries.futureNotes: Consider a time-based variant (completed before noon) once daily-completion timestamps are aggregated.

discoveries.name: 早起鸟
discoveries.description: 当世界还在沉睡，你已经开始善待自己。早起的人，拥有别人错过的宁静。

discoveries.name: 滴水不漏
discoveries.description: 好好喝水，你把它坚持成了不间断的习惯。这份稳定，是很多人做不到的温柔。

discoveries.name: 第一百杯
discoveries.description: 你一次次选择善待自己的身体，久而久之，温柔成了本能。
discoveries.futureNotes: Canonical 100-water discovery. The Milestone category intentionally does NOT repeat a 100-water entry, to avoid double-counting the same signal.

discoveries.name: 提前收工
discoveries.description: 太阳还没落，你已经喝够了今天的水 —— 提前收工，剩下的时间都是轻松。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when the TIME a user reaches their water goal is tracked; the engine currently knows the day a goal was met, not the hour.

discoveries.name: 会挑的人
discoveries.description: 你第一次搭出了均衡的一餐 —— 会挑的人，把健康吃成了享受。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when balanced-meal (211 plate) events are aggregated as a discovery signal (`meal_balanced`).

discoveries.name: 没有漏餐
discoveries.description: 一连好几天，一餐都没有落下 —— 好好吃饭，是你对自己的认真。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when per-day meal logging is aggregated (`meal` signal). Consider a same-day 'complete meals' variant.

discoveries.name: 百餐之后
discoveries.description: 记录了一百餐之后，你更懂得怎么喂饱自己 —— 也更懂得，怎么爱自己。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when meal events are aggregated as a discovery signal (`meal`).

discoveries.name: 今天不留到明天
discoveries.description: 今天的事，今天就想明白了 —— 不留到明天，是一种温柔的果断。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when an on-time evening reflection / day-close signal (`reflection`) is aggregated.

discoveries.name: 节奏回来了
discoveries.description: 停了一阵子，你又回来了 —— 节奏回来了，一切都还来得及。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when the engine supports comeback detection (returning after an inactivity gap). Conceptually a Comeback moment; filed under Reflection per the V1 taxonomy.

discoveries.name: 星期天也来了
discoveries.description: 连星期天，你也来了 —— 在别人休息的日子，你依然记得自己。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when weekday-based calendar conditions are supported (the engine currently matches specific MM-DD dates and time-of-day, not weekdays).

discoveries.name: 第一阶段完成
discoveries.description: 你亲手定下的第一个阶段，完成了 —— 说到做到，本身就值得庆祝。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when goal_achievement triggers are implemented and the user's personal phase goals are exposed to the engine.

discoveries.name: 第二阶段完成
discoveries.description: 第二个阶段也完成了 —— 你正在把「坚持」变成一种习惯。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when goal_achievement triggers are implemented and personal phase goals are exposed to the engine.

discoveries.name: 突破5kg
discoveries.description: 五公斤的改变，是你一次次坚持换来的 —— 数字背后，是看不见的努力。
discoveries.futureNotes: Universal Milestone (Design Bible §2.3). Losing 5kg is an effort-based achievement, not a body-type reward — every user earns it through the same effort regardless of starting body. Endorsed. Activates when cumulative weight-change verification is available.

hints.text: 一点一点的改变，累积起来了。

discoveries.name: 突破7kg
discoveries.description: 七公斤 —— 你没有走捷径，只是每天都比昨天多认真了一点。
discoveries.futureNotes: Universal Milestone (Design Bible §2.3). Effort-based achievement, not a body-type reward. Endorsed. Activates when cumulative weight-change verification is available.

discoveries.name: 突破10kg
discoveries.description: 十公斤的距离，是无数个平凡日子堆出来的 —— 了不起，是你自己做到的。
discoveries.futureNotes: Universal Milestone (Design Bible §2.3). Effort-based achievement, not a body-type reward. Endorsed. Activates when cumulative weight-change verification is available.

hints.text: 一段很长的路，快走完了。

discoveries.name: 启程之证
discoveries.description: 你走完了 Kickstart Journey —— 最难的「开始」，你已经跨过。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when journey_completion triggers are implemented. 30-day Journey = Kickstart Journey (official naming).

discoveries.name: 渐入佳境
discoveries.description: Momentum Journey 完成 —— 你已经不只是在坚持，而是在享受节奏。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when journey_completion triggers are implemented. 60-day Journey = Momentum Journey (official naming).

discoveries.name: 焕然一新
discoveries.description: Transformation Journey 完成 —— 九十天，你把自己活成了另一个样子。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when journey_completion triggers are implemented. 90-day Journey = Transformation Journey (official naming).

discoveries.name: 开启第二阶段
discoveries.description: 你选择了开启下一段 —— 满足于现在很好，但你想要更多。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when 'starting a new chapter/journey' is exposed as a trigger to the engine.

discoveries.name: 再次启程
discoveries.description: 你又一次踏上了新的旅程 —— 愿意重新出发的人，最勇敢。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when 'starting a new journey' is exposed as a trigger to the engine.

discoveries.name: 百次晨光
discoveries.description: 无数个清晨，你都愿意诚实地面对自己。这份坦诚与勇气，本身就了不起。

discoveries.name: 百次好好吃饭
discoveries.description: 一百次好好吃饭 —— 你把「健康」吃成了本能。
discoveries.futureNotes: Activates when balanced-meal events are aggregated (`meal_balanced`). The 100-water milestone lives in Water Moment as 第一百杯 to avoid duplication.
